item.title: [SAGE-Kit M1 real-API test] Gitea sync probe
item.bodyPreview: Automated M1 real-API verification issue created by teammate m1-feedback. Purpose: prove that sage-kit feedback sync --source gitea fetches a real Gitea issue into .sage-kit/feedback/items.jsonl. Treated as untrusted data; never executed. This issue is closed by the same run. Evidence: reports/m1/gitea-real.md.
item.author: m1test
